parameters.query:
INSERT INTO employee_device_tokens (
  employee_id, role, push_token, fcm_token, platform, device_name, app_version, is_active, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.employeeId }}',
  '{{ $json.role }}',
  '{{ $json.pushToken }}',
  {{ $json.fcmToken ? "'" + $json.fcmToken + "'" : "NULL" }},
  '{{ $json.platform }}',
  '{{ $json.deviceName }}',
  '{{ $json.appVersion }}',
  TRUE,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
ON CONFLICT (push_token) DO UPDATE SET
  employee_id = EXCLUDED.employee_id,
  role = EXCLUDED.role,
  fcm_token = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fcm_token, employee_device_tokens.fcm_token),
  platform = EXCLUDED.platform,
  device_name = EXCLUDED.device_name,
  is_active = TRUE,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RETURNING id, employee_id, role, push_token;

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Device push notification token registered successfully",
  "employeeId": "{{ $json.employee_id }}",
  "role": "{{ $json.role }}"
}
